EMOLUMENT POLICY                                                                 薪酬政策
The emolument policy of the employees of the Group is set up by the              薪酬委員會根據本集團僱員之表現、資歷及工

      goods, properties or services to a customer for which the Group has             收取代價（或應自客戶收取代價金額）的
      received consideration (or an amount of consideration is due) from the          貨品、物業或服務的責任。
      customer.

      Existence of significant financing component                                    存在重大融資部分
      In determining the transaction price, the Group adjusts the promised            釐定交易價時，倘協定之付款時間（明
      amount of consideration for the effects of the time value of money if           示或暗示）為客戶或本集團提供有關向
      the timing of payments agreed (either explicitly or implicitly) provides        客戶轉讓貨品或服務之重大融資利益，
      the customer or the Group with a significant benefit of financing the           本集團會就貨幣時間價值之影響調整承
      transfer of goods or services to the customer. In those circumstances,          諾代價金額。於該等情況下，合約即包
      the contract contains a significant financing component. A significant          含重大融資部分。不論融資承諾是否明
      financing component may exist regardless of whether the promise of              確列於合約或隱含在合約訂約方協定
      financing is explicitly stated in the contract or implied by the payment        之付款條款中，均可能存在重大融資部
      terms agreed to by the parties to the contract.                                 分。

      For contracts where the period between payment and transfer of the              對於付款與轉讓相關貨品、物業或服務
      associated goods, properties or service is less than one year, the              相隔期間不足一年之合約，本集團應用
      Group applies the practical expedient of not adjusting the transaction          可行權宜之計，而不就任何重大融資部
      price for any significant financing component.                                  分調整交易價。

      For advance payments received from customers before the transfer                就於轉移本集團已就任何重大融資部分
      of the associated goods, properties or services in which the Group              而調整已承諾之代價金額之相關貨品、
      adjusts for the promised amount of consideration for a significant              物業或服務前自客戶收取之預付款項而
      financing component, the Group applies a discount rate that would be            言，本集團應用將於本集團與客戶之間
      reflected in a separate financing transaction between the Group and             於合約開始之獨立融資交易中反映之折
      the customer at contract inception. The relevant interest expenses              現率。預收款項與轉讓相關貨品及服務
      during the period between the advance payments were received and                兩者期間之有關利息開支，使用與借貸
      the transfer of the associated goods and services are accounted for             成本相同的基準入賬。
      on the same basis as other borrowing costs.

39. CAPITAL RISK MANAGEMENT                                                     39. 資本風險管理
      The Group manages its capital to ensure that entities in the Group will     本集團管理其資本以確保通過優化債務
      be able to continue as a going concern while maximising the return to       與股本結存為權益持有人爭取最高回
      stakeholders through the optimisation of the debt and equity balance.       報，使集團旗下實體能夠持續經營。本
      The Group’s overall strategy remains unchanged from prior year.             集團之整體策略與過往年度相同。

      The capital structure of the Group consists of bank borrowings, net         本集團之資本結構包括銀行借貸、現金
      of cash and cash equivalents and equity attributable to owners of           及現金等值項目淨額及本公司持有人應
      the Company, comprising issued share capital, other reserves and            佔權益（包括已發行股本、其他儲備及
      retained profits as disclosed in the consolidated statement of changes      保留溢利），在綜合權益變動表內披露。
      in equity.

      The Directors review the capital structure on a semi-annual basis.          董事每半年審閱資本結構。作為審閱一
      As part of this review, the Directors consider the cost of capital and      部分，董事將考慮資本成本，及與各類
      the risks associated with each class of capital. In the opinion of the      別資本相關之風險。董事認為本集團將
      Directors, the Group will balance its overall capital structure through     通過支付股息、發行新股、購回股份、
      the payment of dividends, new share issues and share buy-backs as           發行新債或者贖回現有債項，以平衡整
      well as the issue of new debt or the redemption of existing debt.           體資本結構。
